title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Measures for the Issuance of the Honorary Balance Commemorative Medal
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Measures for the Issuance of the Honorary Balance Commemorative Medal

Fa Fa [2019] No. 30

The High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army, and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Measures for the Issuance of the Honorary Balance Commemorative Medal are hereby issued for your earnest implementation.

December 3, 2019

Measures for the Issuance of the Honorary Balance Commemorative Medal

Article 1: To encourage staff of the people's courts to dedicate themselves to the people's judicial cause for a long period, to enhance their professional honor and pride, to motivate cadres to take on new responsibilities and make new achievements in the new era, and to actively contribute to the construction of the socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics, the Honorary Balance Commemorative Medal is established and these Measures are formulated in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Regulations on National Meritorious Service Commendation.

Article 2: The Honorary Balance Commemorative Medal is an honorary commemorative medal, focusing on spiritual encouragement, and does not entail any related benefits.

Article 3: The scope of issuance of the Honorary Balance Commemorative Medal shall be to personnel on the staff of people's courts at all levels (including directly affiliated institutions) who have worked in the people's courts for a cumulative total of 30 years and have contributed to the work of the people's courts.

Article 4: For staff of the people's courts who have worked for a long period in remote, high-altitude, and cold regions, the working years requirement for issuance of the Honorary Balance Commemorative Medal may be appropriately relaxed, but the actual number of years engaged in the work of the people's court in such regions shall be no less than 20 years. Specific measures shall be formulated by each High People's Court in accordance with relevant provisions and in light of the actual conditions of its region, and shall be reported to the Supreme People's Court for filing.

Article 5: Where a person has left their current position for temporary assignment or for approved off-the-job study, and has returned to work in the people's court after the temporary assignment or off-the-job study, the period of service in the court may be calculated consecutively.

Article 6: To maintain the seriousness of the honor and incentive of the Honorary Balance Commemorative Medal, strict review and verification shall be conducted for the following persons before issuance:

(1) For those whose annual assessment is rated as "incompetent," issuance shall be temporarily withheld for the period from the year in which the assessment rating is determined (inclusive) until the year in which they are next rated as "competent" or above (exclusive);
(2) For those under investigation by disciplinary inspection and supervision departments, or during the period of receiving Party discipline or administrative disciplinary sanctions, or during criminal proceedings, issuance shall be temporarily withheld;
(3) For those who have received Party disciplinary sanctions such as removal from Party posts or probation within the Party, or administrative sanctions such as major demerit, demotion, or removal from office, after the conclusion of the enforcement of such sanctions, from the following year onward, their work unit shall make an appraisal based on the nature of their mistake and their usual performance; after review by the relevant High People's Court, issuance may proceed only upon approval by the Supreme People's Court;
(4) For those who have been expelled from the Party, dismissed from public office, or subjected to criminal punishment, the medal shall not be issued.

Article 7: The Honorary Balance Commemorative Medal shall be issued in the name of the Supreme People's Court, generally once a year, and a certificate shall be issued simultaneously.

Article 8: The list of persons meeting the issuance conditions shall be reviewed and proposed by the people's court where they work, reported level by level to the High People's Court for re-examination, and then submitted to the Supreme People's Court for final approval. The medal may be issued directly by the Supreme People's Court, or it may be delegated to local people's courts at various levels for issuance on its behalf.

Article 9: A special ceremony may be held for the issuance of the Honorary Balance Commemorative Medal, or it may be combined with annual summary and commendation activities. The issuance ceremony shall be dignified and simple, highlighting the significance of spiritual encouragement and ideological education.

Article 10: The Honorary Balance Commemorative Medal shall be uniformly manufactured by the Supreme People's Court and managed by serial number. The medal shall have a diameter of 48 millimeters, be made of gold-plated copper, and bear the inscription "Honorary Balance Commemorative Medal" on the front.

Article 11: The costs for the manufacture and distribution of the Honorary Balance Commemorative Medal and its certificate shall be included within the scope of the business expenditure guarantee of the Supreme People's Court.

Article 12: The work of issuing the Honorary Balance Commemorative Medal shall be conducted with seriousness and rigor. In case of any fraudulent conduct, the Honorary Balance Commemorative Medal and certificate shall be recovered, and the matter shall be investigated and dealt with severely in accordance with regulations.

Article 13: The wearing, safekeeping, promotional use, and supervisory management of the medal shall, mutatis mutandis, be governed by the relevant provisions of the Measures for the Administration of Medals, Orders, and Commemorative Medals (Trial).

Article 14: Persons who have already received an Honorary Balance Medal before the implementation of these Measures shall no longer be issued the Honorary Balance Commemorative Medal.

Article 15: These Measures shall be interpreted by the Political Department of the Supreme People's Court.

Article 16: These Measures shall come into effect on December 11, 2019. The Measures of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Honorary Balance Medal (Fa Fa [2012] No. 29) shall be simultaneously abolished.
